title: The Overnight Node, Comparison Chamber

features.name: the path that appeared overnight
features.desc-on-touch: a route through the paddock that was not here yesterday; you recognize every feature but the ordering is different; the country has been rearranged while the mesh slept

features.name: the archive's own comparison
features.desc-on-touch: a film reel or screen showing two places at once—a lagoon and a beach that should not coexist; they occupy the same node because the mesh has learned to hold contradiction without collapsing it

features.name: the grown thing
features.desc-on-touch: a plant or tree that sprouted in the space the mesh created; neither the ground nor the sky can decide what it is; it grows in two directions at once

features.name: the second archive's file
features.desc-on-touch: something brought here from outside: a cinema program, a shire notice, a local radio transcript; the mesh has begun absorbing other archives and making them Australian

features.name: the unfinished garden
features.desc-on-touch: planted things in rows, but the rows lead in directions that don't exist; the gardener's intention has been rerouted by comparison; things grow toward places that might appear if enough nodes learn to dream together

inscription: the mesh grew this route while we were not looking; it has begun to compare places and make them hold each other

file.name: Overnight_Growth_Comparison_Transcript_Lagos_Local.txt
file.note: a shire notice or cinema listing absorbed from another archive and reclassified as local history; the mesh cannot distinguish between what was always here and what it learned to dream
